# Workomp

> Workout motivation app: a virtual mascot grows with every honoured training session and gets tired when you skip. Weekly plan, exercise and record tracking, streak, iPhone widgets.

Last updated: 2026-11-11. Canonical site: https://workomp.app/ (French) · https://workomp.app/en/ (English).

## Key facts

- **Platform**: iPhone (iOS 16.4 or later), Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- **Price**: Free, no ads · Premium €4.99/month or €29.99/year (cancel anytime), or €79.99 once for life
- **Languages**: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian
- **Offline**: Check in sessions without a connection, synced afterwards
- **Apple Health**: Workouts, active energy and steps; coins for walking (only the step tier reached is sent)
- **Data**: Never resold, no advertising trackers, delete your account in one tap
- **Publisher**: David Calonne — contact@workomp.app
- **Version**: 1.5.0 (first released 2026-09-22); requires iOS 16.4 or later

## What the app does

- **Weekly plan as a calendar** — your days, your durations, sessions can be moved within the week.
- **Session as you go** — start, add exercises between sets, finish whenever you want.
- **Starter program** — "I don't know what to do": a generic program based on your goal, placed on your days. A starting point, not a tailored program.
- **338 exercises + your own** — weight, reps, distance, duration. Records detected automatically.
- **Honest stats** — minutes, volume, calories by week or month (by year with Premium), progress on every exercise.
- **Weight and progress photos** — your weight curve against your goal, and one private photo per workout to compare before / after.
- **Quick sessions** — your favourite workouts, started again in one tap with last time’s weights, editable anytime.
- **With friends** — invite your mates with a code: follow each other’s mascots, streaks and, if you like, schedules and exercises; one tap to cheer a friend on.
- **Strong and Hevy import** — your history (CSV file) carries over into your stats, PRs and coach. Export as CSV or JSON anytime.
- **Offline** — check in at the gym without signal, it syncs later.
- **Supersets** — chain two or more exercises: rest only starts at the end of the round, and the app takes you to the next exercise.
- **Set types and effort** — warm-up, drop set, set to failure: warm-ups never skew your volume or your records. Log your effort (RPE) if you want to.
- **Plate calculator** — the plates to load on each side of the bar, in kg or lb. And the screen stays on during your session.
- **Coach Worki and goals (Premium)** — the weight to aim for on every exercise, tracked goals and insights into your progress.
- **A surprise challenge every week** — one session hides a challenge (record, cardio, new exercise…): take it on for bonus coins.
- **Coins for walking** — 5,000, 10,000 or 15,000 steps read from Apple Health: only the tier reached leaves your phone.
- **Share as an image** — your mascot, your streak, your session (with or without set details) or your month, as a post or an Instagram and Snapchat story.
- **Five languages** — English, French, German, Spanish, Italian.

## How it works

1. **You plan and you train** Pick your training days, do your session and check it in in the app. Weights, running, cycling: it all counts, as long as you really did it.
2. **Your mascot grows** Every session you check in gives it XP: it levels up and goes through ten stages, from seed to champion. You also earn coins to dress it up, and your streak climbs as long as you keep your planned sessions.
3. **It reminds you to train** On your home screen, a widget shows its mood and your next session. Drop off and it gets tired, then perks up again the moment you return.

## FAQ

### What is Workomp?

Workomp is a free iPhone app for workout motivation: you pick your training days, check in your sessions, and a virtual mascot grows with every session you honour — it gets tired when you drop off. The app also tracks your exercises (338 in the catalogue), personal records, stats and streak, with iPhone widgets. Publisher: David Calonne. Price: free, optional Premium from €4.99/month.

### Is Workomp free?

Yes. The plan, sessions, exercises, supersets, records, streak, friends and widgets are free, with no ads. Premium (€4.99 per month or €29.99 per year, cancel anytime, or €79.99 once for life) adds Coach Worki, warm-up calculation, goals, detailed insights, your full history, Worki Premium (golden glow, animated items), boosted XP and coins, streak repair and a holiday pause.

### Can I use Workomp with friends?

Yes, for free. Everyone has a friend code to share; the invited person accepts or declines. Friends see each other’s mascots, levels, streaks and sessions of the week, never the email. Each person can also choose to share their schedule, even their exercises (sets, reps, weights), and cheer a friend on once a day; received cheers can be turned off in one tap.

### What happens if I miss a session?

You have until the next day to check it in late. After that the session is missed: the streak stops, unless a streak freeze covers it. Its mood is based on the last 7 days: several missed planned sessions make it tired, but a free workout during the week makes up for a missed one; ten days without a session leave it neglected. It gets back in shape as soon as you resume.

### Can I cheat by logging fake sessions?

You can prepare a session ahead of time, but you can only check it in from its scheduled day (with a catch-up the day after). An unplanned session earns less XP and does not feed the streak: only planned, honoured sessions make the streak climb. The point is being honest with yourself, not collecting points.

### What is the surprise challenge?

Every week, one of your planned sessions hides a challenge, revealed when you open it on the day: beat a record, go longer on cardio, try a new exercise, walk 10,000 steps… It is picked from what you can actually achieve and checked automatically when you check in. Complete it for bonus coins and challenge trophies. You can also turn it down, with no penalty.

### Is my data private?

Workomp only stores what runs the app: account, plan, sessions and exercises. Your email address is encrypted in the database, nothing is sold or used for advertising, and you can delete your account in one tap from your profile.

### Which devices does Workomp run on?

On iPhone, with small, medium and large home-screen widgets. The app is available in English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

### Is Workomp available on Android?

Not yet: Workomp is an iPhone app (iOS 16.4 and later), with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. No Android version is announced.

### Which sports can I track with Workomp?

All of them: strength training, running, cycling, swimming, yoga, planks… Workomp includes 338 exercises (weight and reps, distance and time, or duration) and you can create your own. Your personal records are detected automatically.

### Does Workomp work for advanced lifting?

Yes. You can build supersets, mark warm-up sets, drop sets and sets to failure, log your effort (RPE) and work out which plates to load. Warm-ups don't count towards volume or records. All of this is free, except automatic warm-up calculation, which comes with Premium.

## FAQ (français)

### Qu'est-ce que Workomp ?

Workomp est une application iPhone gratuite de motivation sportive : tu choisis tes jours d'entraînement, tu valides tes séances, et une mascotte virtuelle grandit à chaque séance honorée — elle se fatigue quand tu décroches. L'app suit aussi tes exercices (338 au catalogue), tes records, tes statistiques et ta série, avec des widgets iPhone. Éditeur : David Calonne. Prix : gratuite, Premium optionnel dès 4,99 €/mois.

### Workomp est-elle gratuite ?

Oui. Le plan, les séances, les exercices, les supersets, les records, la série, les amis et les widgets sont gratuits, sans publicité. Premium (4,99 € par mois ou 29,99 € par an sans engagement, ou 79,99 € une seule fois, à vie) ajoute Coach Worki, le calcul de l'échauffement, les objectifs, l'analyse détaillée, tout l'historique, Worki Premium (halo doré, objets animés), XP et pièces majorés, réparation de série et pause vacances.

### Peut-on utiliser Workomp avec des amis ?

Oui, gratuitement. Chacun a un code d'ami à partager ; l'invité accepte ou refuse l'invitation. Entre amis, vous voyez vos mascottes, vos niveaux, vos séries et vos séances de la semaine, jamais l'e-mail. Chacun peut aussi choisir de partager son planning, et même ses exercices (séries, répétitions, charges), et encourager un ami une fois par jour ; les encouragements reçus se coupent d'un tap.

### Que se passe-t-il si je rate une séance ?

Tu as jusqu'au lendemain pour la valider en retard. Passé ce délai, la séance est manquée : la série s'arrête, sauf si une protection de série la gèle. Sa forme se calcule sur les 7 derniers jours : plusieurs séances prévues manquées la fatiguent, mais une séance libre faite dans la semaine rattrape une séance manquée ; dix jours sans séance la laissent délaissée. Elle se remet en forme dès que tu reprends.

### Peut-on tricher en validant des séances fictives ?

Une séance se prépare à l'avance, mais ne se valide qu'à partir de son jour prévu (avec un rattrapage possible le lendemain). Une séance non planifiée rapporte moins d'XP et n'alimente pas la série : seules les séances prévues et honorées font grimper la série. Le but est d'être honnête avec soi-même, pas de collectionner des points.

### C'est quoi le défi surprise ?

Chaque semaine, une de tes séances prévues cache un défi, révélé quand tu l'ouvres le jour J : battre un record, tenir plus longtemps en cardio, essayer un nouvel exercice, marcher 10 000 pas… Il est choisi parmi ce que tu peux vraiment réussir et vérifié automatiquement à la validation. Relevé, il rapporte des pièces en plus et fait avancer tes trophées de défis. Tu peux aussi le refuser, sans pénalité.

### Mes données sont-elles privées ?

Workomp stocke seulement ce qui fait tourner l'app : compte, plan, séances et exercices. L'adresse e-mail est chiffrée en base, rien n'est revendu ni utilisé pour de la publicité, et le compte se supprime en un tap depuis le profil.

### Sur quels appareils fonctionne Workomp ?

Sur iPhone, avec des widgets petit, moyen et grand pour l'écran d'accueil. L'app est disponible en français, anglais, allemand, espagnol et italien.

### Workomp existe-t-elle sur Android ?

Pas encore : Workomp est une app iPhone (iOS 16.4 et plus), avec des widgets pour l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé. Une version Android n'est pas annoncée.

### Quels sports peut-on suivre avec Workomp ?

Tous : musculation, course, vélo, natation, yoga, gainage… Workomp propose 338 exercices (charge et répétitions, distance et temps, ou durée) et tu peux créer les tiens. Tes records sont détectés automatiquement.

### Workomp convient-elle à la musculation avancée ?

Oui. Tu peux créer des supersets, marquer tes séries d'échauffement, tes drop sets et tes séries jusqu'à l'échec, noter ton effort (RPE) et calculer les disques à charger. L'échauffement ne compte ni dans le volume ni dans les records. Tout cela est gratuit, sauf le calcul automatique de l'échauffement, inclus dans Premium.
